description:
Run a fresh HTTP/MCP/assert diagnostic and return signed evidence for delegation.
    Same 1-credit completed-check price, no signing surcharge. Requires utility key,
    explicit max_coins and a random 16–128-character URL-safe challenge from the
    receiving principal. The signature binds the exact URL and assertions by hash,
    result, observation time and nonce. Broken targets can produce valid signed
    failure evidence; a valid signature does not mean success. Worker/signing
    failures cost zero. Reuse request_key for uncertain retries: returns the SAME
    original bundle, never renews its five-minute expiry. No generic signing of
    caller-provided claims. Read internet_utils_instructions for verifier guidance.
name: run_signed_diagnostic
